cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Which label colour suits these boxes?

mechanism: A performs exacting moving-label design to keep B focused on small presentation choices rather than the boxes A has not packed.
confusable: D24 finds a larger problem in details; this A already has a larger duty failure and uses details to prevent addressing it.
comparison: Kitchen alternative redirects a family cleaning offer; moving alternative redirects the arrival of transport into label visibility.
seedUse: Empty boxes, label colours and van arrival derive from D38-b; S03 adds readable marking and outward orientation as expert distractions.
